commits.comment: 本次为 DynamicCVPipeline 的大规模重构与保护性修复（41 文件，+2535/-301）。要点：(1) 新增 ProtectTcbReuse pass 及 VF/ST 两个子 pass，通过 collectProtectionPlans 在 VECTOR/CUBE main loop 前插入 hivm.hir.sync_block_set/wait（PIPE_V/PIPE_MTE3 -> PIPE_FIX）保护 TCB 复用，并在 ProtectTcbReuse.cpp 中组合；策略要求 outer loop 恰有 2 个 main loop pair、所有 flag 资源可静态分配，否则跳过（skip 而非失败）。(2) UBUsageOptPass 在 collectRecordChange 中过滤非 VECTOR_ONLY 依赖，修复 CUBE op 被拖入 VECTOR block 导致 block_id/core_type 混用。(3) MergeSmallBlockPass 用 BlockDependencyGraph 拓扑序替换 program order，检测到环时 setFallbackAttr；同时调用上移到 Common/Utils 的 isTensorComputeOp（并新增 fill 可被 InlineBrc 消除的判定与 pcb10_tc01_kernel legacy 分支）。(4) MergeCubeBlock/MergeComputeBlock 删除 kMergeComputeBlockApplied 标记与 mergedAny 跟踪，ReorderOpsByBlockId 不再据此跳过，改为 always 重排且引入“首个 CUBE 组运行前优先小 VECTOR 组”的排序策略。(5) PlanVectorBlock 的 isTensorOperation 改为 walk 嵌套区域，并新增 hasEarlierCubeUser 避免不必要的 deferred。(6) SplittedIfWrapSsbufIf 跳过 scf.while。(7) 删除 InterCoreTransferAndSync 的 hasStartEndSyncWhitelistKernel、Utils.cpp 的 outline 黑名单被 return false 短路（注释保留）。风险点：插入的 handshake 若 flag 资源不足会静默跳过（仅日志），correctness 依赖 npuir 自身；拓扑序在含环时会 fallback 整个 pipeline；黑名单被短路意味着 outline reuse 对所有 kernel 开放，需注意回归。

test_impact.reason: 新增 ProtectTcbReuse 三个 pass 及 8 个 lit 用例（combined/cloned-bounds/main-loop-count/store-tail-count/vf-matching/vf-shared-tensor-compute/marked-main-loops-without-fix），新增 merge_small_block、merge_small_block_region_core_type、ub_usage_opt_block_id_core_type、plan_vector_block_region_tensor、test_view_memory_effects；同时 merge_cube_block_multiple_loops、test_plan_compute_block_shared_load_scope/subview_memory_deps、splitted-if-wrap 用例期望被改写。新增矩阵较大，需看护 pass 顺序（ProtectTcbReuse 插在 AnalyzeDataFlow 之后、AllocMultiCache 之前）。

commits.message:
[ssbuffer](feat) Refactor && Protect tcb reuse in some scenario (#3261)

* [ssbuffer](fix) UB usage opt must not move CUBE ops into a VECTOR block

collectRecordChange pulls every transitive dependency of the chain nodes
into the target block. For a chain node that depends on a CUBE op, that
CUBE op was picked up too and had its ssbuffer.block_id rewritten from the
cube block to the VECTOR optBlockId, breaking the CUBE/VECTOR split that
later passes rely on. On a kernel with a matmul feeding VECTOR arithmetic,
the matmul ended up tagged with a VECTOR block_id.

Gate the dependency move on a pure VECTOR_ONLY core type. Read it through
getCoreTypeOfSimpleOpOrCf rather than the graph snapshot, because control
flow ops carry a per-operand comma list ("CUBE, CUBE, ...") on their
attribute while their real core type comes from aggregating the ops inside
their region.

* [ssbuffer](fix) topologically sort block

* init

* unify

* [ssbuffer](fix) Protect tcb reuse in some scenario

* [ssbuffer](fix) Better reorder and loop-carried value planning.

* [ssbuffer](fix) Small VECTOR block without CUBE should come first

* [ssbuffer](fix) while/if keep ssbuffer is outter than mne

commits.comment: TLA 语言扩展的一次成体系功能提交，可拆为五条主线：（1）实验性 API 治理：新增 tla/_decorator.py 的 experimental 装饰器，在 kernel 编译的调用点用 warnings.warn_explicit 发出 UserWarning，并通过包装 __signature__ 注入 _generator 关键字以获取 CodeGenerator 的源码位置，用于提示 TLA 实验性接口；（2）声明式流水线：新增 tla.pipeline(num_iters)（scope.py 中 @experimental @builtin），在 code_generator.py 中以 TLACodeGenerator 重写 _visit_pipeline 生成 create_tla_pipeline（scf.for + hivm.cv_pipelined_loop 属性），并在每个 stage 生成 create_tla_stage 与 hivm.preload_num/max_preload_num 标记，同时校验 stage 非递减、禁止嵌套/break/continue/return/loop-carried、禁止在 scope 或 while 中嵌套；（3）编译选项透传：新增 tla/_options.py 的 npuir_extra_options 校验与归一化，_backend.py 中以 FunctionType 重新绑定 ascend.subprocess.run/shlex.join 的 shim 在 bishengir-compile 的 -o 之前插入额外 argv，且要求 argv[0] 必须是 bishengir-compile；（4）同步策略推断：C++ 侧 tla_builder.cc 新增 get_tla_kernel_features 扫描 hivm set/wait/barrier/getbuf/rlsbuf（intra）、sync_block_*（cross）、annotation multi_buffer、cv_pipelined_loop、UnitFlag 接口，Python 侧 infer_sync_options 据此校验“手写同步 vs 自动注入同步”的互斥关系，并对 tla.pipeline 情形禁止任何手写同步/多 buffer/disable 标志；（5）缓存与 JIT 路径：jit.py 移除原有 TLASTSource.parse_options 返回 _frontend_kind 的注入，改为 hash() 加 'tla:' 前缀（隔离 TLA 与非 TLA 缓存），create_binder 用 make_backend 构造 TLA backend 的 binder，_pack_args 与 run 中剥离/归一化 npuir_extra_options，_TLABackend 关闭 get_jit_reuse_handler 并覆写 add_stages 注入 ttadapter 与自定义 npubin stage。C++ 侧另有 create_tla_stage（把多个 task scope 合并为单一 scope.scope）、create_tla_pipeline 返回值由 pair 改为 tuple 并多返回 can_preload（batch=1 时不 preload）、GM view 的 make_tensor_ptr 在形性/stride 动态时打 tla.gm_view 属性，TLAToLinalgPass.cpp 新增 TLAMakeTensorPtrConverter 将带 tla.gm_view 的 make_tensor_ptr 转为 memref.reinterpret_cast（要求 offsets 全为 0、复用基底指针、保留负偏移），以正确支持动态 GM view。潜在风险：缓存键由 ASTSource.hash 加前缀，会改变 TLA kernel 的磁盘缓存命中行为；infer_sync_options 的互斥规则较严格，可能误拒用户合法的组合（如 tla.pipeline 内一切手写同步都报错）；_compile_binary 通过替换 ascend.subprocess/shlex 实现 argv 注入，依赖 stage 中以关键字调用 ascend.subprocess.run/shlex.join 的实现细节，若上游改动调用方式会失效；experimental 装饰器依赖 Trition CodeGenerator 传 _generator 的内部约定；create_tla_pipeline 的 can_preload 仅依据 stop 是否为常量 IntOp 判断，动态 stop 恒为 True。整体是 TLA 从“脚本式 scope”向“可调度流水线 DSL”的能力升级，属于实验性 API 的引入，符合提交中对 experimental 的标注预期。

commits.message:
[TLA](fix) Align GM/UB DMA APIs with A5 support (#3279)

Expose LoadGM2UBParams.l2_cache_ctrl with L2CachePolicy.NORMAL_FV and
NORMAL_LV. Resolve omitted or None configuration explicitly to NORMAL_FV.
Keep existing member names and meanings stable as future L2 modes are added.
Bridge to the existing HIVM EvictFirst/EvictLast attributes; NPUIR retains
the hardware-value conversion. Remove the old public names and EvictNormal.

Remove all load_gm_to_ub padding configuration and native padding operands.
Document the intrinsic 32-byte alignment fill: Normal mode fills each burst,
while Ascend 950 Compact mode fills the combined region. Callers must reserve
and synchronize the full physical UB write footprint.

Remove StoreUB2GMParams, the store_ub_to_gm params argument and native
attribute forwarding. Adapt copy dispatch and DMA callers while preserving
independent set_atomic control and explicit reset. Delete unsupported
padding and per-store atomic test configurations without adding negatives.

Validation: matching wheel passed 5228 frontend/IR tests with 113 stage
skips and 32 DMA/copy tests on physical NPU0 (load/store 15, ND2NZ 15,
copy-only 2). Six direct-load/copy target-compilation and disassembly probes
confirmed None/NORMAL_FV/NORMAL_LV cache values 0/0/1; these extra probes
did not launch kernels. Cache hit rate and performance were not measured.

commits.message:
[TLA](fix) Add additional constraints (#3149)

* [TLA](fix) Enforce explicit resources for scalar conversions

Reject numeric fp64 conversions to narrower floating-point types in the
Python tla.cast frontend, including literal inputs and calls through JIT
helpers. Keep same-type casts and legal bitcasts, and retain the existing
BF16 source and destination restrictions at the scalar API boundary.

Cover the scalar type matrix, floating formats, rounding modes, FP64
literals and helper diagnostics without changing other TLA interfaces or
the shared adapter pipeline.

Validation: local scalar frontend checks passed in an isolated runtime
using an existing native build and compatible builder bindings. Python
syntax and git diff whitespace checks passed. No wheel rebuild, target
compilation or device execution was performed.

Assisted-by: AI
Signed-off-by: lbqg <songyaofei2@huawei.com>

* [TLA](fix) Reject scalar operations inside SIMD VFs

Reject select, abs, maximum, minimum, cast, cdiv and clamp inside SIMD
VFs, including literal inputs. Preserve max_value and infinity as typed
constant constructors allowed in either execution domain. Share the
execution-domain guard through scope.py for reuse by other TLA modules.

Record effective core and VF modes in the TLA caller context and carry
them into JIT helper specializations and callee initialization. SIMD
retains Vector ownership when a pure VV kernel omits the explicit Vector
scope. Restore the previous caller and builder contexts on scope exit.

Cover direct calls, helper reuse, control flow and constant exceptions.
Keep scalar clamp computation outside SIMD VFs.

Validation: 76 existing frontend contracts passed locally in an isolated
runtime using an existing native build and compatible builder bindings.
Python syntax and git diff whitespace checks passed. No wheel rebuild,
target compilation or device execution was performed.

Assisted-by: AI
Signed-off-by: lbqg <songyaofei2@huawei.com>

commits.message:
[TLA](feat) refactor copy&alloc_buffer&view&subview (#3224)

* [TLA](feat) refactor copy and alloc_buffer

Reapply #3143 on top of main-dev after its revert.

Remove the generic tla.copy dispatcher and the alloc_buffer alias;
callers use the explicit DMA route APIs (load_gm_to_ub,
store_ub_to_gm, load_gm_to_l1, ...) and tla.alloc with space=.

Assisted-by: AI

* [TLA](refactor) drop alloc versions and scope kwargs

Motivation: slim the alloc surface; versions and scope were redundant
spellings that can be expressed with existing public APIs.
Design: alloc now takes only shape/dtype/space. Multi-buffering is
requested explicitly via tla.annotate_buffer_versions(buf, n), which
emits the same hivm.multi_buffer annotation the old versions kwarg
forwarded to; N=1 remains a no-op. scope= callers switch to space=.
Tests updated accordingly, and the invalid-argument case now covers
annotate_buffer_versions directly.
Risks: behavioral parity is static (same callee, same value, same
emission point); error message wording changes slightly for the
positive-integer check.

Assisted-by: AI

* [TLA](feat) split view/subview roles and support dynamic dims

Motivation: tla.view previously accepted non-GM buffer sources while
subview only supported dynamic offsets. Users need a clear split (view
wraps GM kernel pointers only, subview slices buffers in any address
space) plus mixed static/dynamic sizes and strides end to end.

Design: view() now takes a scalar GM pointer only and forwards mixed
static/dynamic shape/strides/offsets through create_tla_pointer_view
(tt.make_tensor_ptr bridge, lowered to memref.reinterpret_cast), with
runtime row-major products as default strides. subview() lowers to
memref.subview with mixed OpFoldResult offsets/sizes/strides; dynamic
dims map to None in buffer_type and -1 in IR types. Remove the unused
create_tla_bind/create_tla_reinterpret_cast entries and the buffer
source path of view(); migrate the non-GM reshape case to subview and
align the frontend contract tests.

Risks: the C++ extension must be rebuilt; subview on GM buffers relies
on the bridge conversion without dedicated coverage.

Assisted-by: AI

* [TLA](test) migrate buffer view calls to subview, add dynamic UT

Motivation: after the view/subview role split, unittest still carried
the legacy buffer-source tla.view calls that the new frontend rejects,
and the dynamic-dimension capabilities plus subview-on-GM had no
dedicated coverage (flagged as a risk in the split commit).

Design: migrate all 22 buffer-source view calls in dsa_kernel.py plus
the expand.py UB row view to tla.subview with the new keyword
signature, and fix the stale positional subview call in reshape.py.
Add vector/view_dynamic.py, a 3-in-1 case covering runtime shape/
stride/offset on the GM pointer entry, subview on a GM view, and
dynamic pitched subview out of a UB allocation, each asserting the
mixed static/dynamic memref types and runtime operands at the IR stage
and exact-window accuracy at run stage. Extend view_frontend_contract
with GM-space preservation, dynamic-extent default strides, and
dynamic-entry bounds-check skip contracts.

Risks: IR/compile/run stages of the new tests were syntax-checked
only and still need execution on a Linux/NPU test machine.

Assisted-by: AI

* [TLA](refactor) rename annotate_buffer_versions to annotate_multi_buffer

Motivation: the old name required knowing that "buffer versions" means
multi-buffering; the new name states the intent directly and matches
the hivm.multi_buffer IR attribute it emits.
Design: mechanical rename of the definition, exports, docstrings and
all call sites in the TLA UTs; no behavior change.
Risks: None.

Assisted-by: AI

* [TLA] chore: fix yapf and clang-format violations

Motivation: files touched by the recent view/subview and rename commits
violated the repo yapf (column_limit=120) and clang-format rules, which
made the pre-commit hooks fail and block commits.
Design: run yapf -i on the affected Python files and clang-format -i on
tla_builder.cc; pure reformatting with no behavior change.
Risks: None.

Assisted-by: AI

commits.message:
[TLA](fix) Pass empty vcvt mode attr to VFTruncF/VFExtF (#3301)

* [build](chore) Update AscendNPU-IR submodule to stable e02c692a6

Motivation: triton-ascend should track the latest origin/stable tip of
AscendNPU-IR instead of a stale gitlink. The index pinned bd228faec while
the working tree had drifted to 1389120d7 (legacy-interface line), and both
predate the 11.19 stable sync.

Design: move the AscendNPU-IR gitlink to e02c692a6 (!5318 merge
sync1119/ab81b53f into stable), the current tip of origin/stable, which
supersedes the legacy-interface line.

Risks: the diff spans the 11.16 -> 11.19 stable syncs; libtriton must be
rebuilt against the new submodule and TLA offline IR re-validated.

Assisted-by: AI
Signed-off-by: liupengcheng2012 <liupengcheng38@huawei.com>

* [TLA](fix) Pass empty vcvt mode attr to VFTruncF/VFExtF

Motivation: the AscendNPU-IR stable bump to e02c692a6 pulled in 019bcd228
("support more vcvtff type conversions"), which appended
OptionalAttr<AVE_VCVT_ModeTypeAttr>:$mode to AVE_VFTruncFOp and
AVE_VFExtFOp. ODS emits optional attributes as positional create()
arguments without C++ defaults, so the two TLA builder call sites stopped
compiling ("requires 9 arguments, but 8 were provided").

Design: pass hivmave::VCVT_ModeTypeAttr{} (unset) at both call sites. TLA
already implements zeroing/merging through applySimdMode's vsel, and the
HIVMAVE-to-AVE lowering falls back to MERGING when the attribute is
absent, so the emitted code is unchanged.

Risks: None; the new attribute stays unset, matching the pre-bump behavior.

Assisted-by: AI
Signed-off-by: liupengcheng2012 <liupengcheng38@huawei.com>

* [CI](chore) Remove Build-Pinned-Wheels job from the Wheels workflow

Motivation: the job compiled AscendNPU-IR in-image on both x86_64 and
aarch64 (480-minute timeout each) to produce a verification wheel for the
pinned submodule revision, which is too expensive for PRs. Drop it along
with the plumbing that existed only for it: the pinned_wheel
workflow_dispatch input and the third_party/ascend/AscendNPU-IR path
trigger.

Design: delete the job block and its two inputs from ascend-wheels.yml.
Build-Wheels keeps tracking the AscendNPU-IR stable branch through the
prebuilt payload, and no other job consumed the pinned wheel artifact.

Risks: PRs that move the submodule pin no longer get an end-to-end wheel
bundling that exact revision; the pinned combination is still compiled by
the regular CI build jobs.

Assisted-by: AI
Signed-off-by: liupengcheng2012 <liupengcheng38@huawei.com>
